This Miscellaneous Second Appeal is filed challenging the order dated 21.11.2017 passed in M.A.No.10011/2017 by the V Additional District and Sessions Judge, Shivamogga, sitting at Sagar and the order dated 24.08.2016 passed in LAC No.01/2011 by the Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Sagar for enhancement of compensation.
2.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, Shivamogga
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is the case of the claimants that there are super structure on the land in Sy.No.110 of Begadhali Village.
The lands at Sy.Nos.191 and 110 are adjacent to each other.
According to the claimant, the super structure was on the land in Sy.No.110 of Begadhali Village.
The SLAO has determined the compensation for both the lands at NC: 2024:KHC:51232 Sy.No.191 and on the super structure.
The SLAO has determined the compensation of Rs.1,09,434/-.

The claimant has filed an application under Section 18(3) of the Land Acquisition Act for seeking to refer to the Reference Court in respect of superstructure on the land in Sy.No.191 of Bedahalli Village.

Since the same is refused, the claimant filed CRP No.3516/1994 before this Court and this Court, on 28.05.1999 has allowed the said CRP and matter was remitted to the Reference Court to determine whether there is any super structure acquired by the Government and if super structure was acquired by the Government, to deal with the reference for enhancement with respect to the super structure, in accordance with law.

The SLAO has referred the application in so far as the land in Sy.No.191 is concerned, but has declined to refer to in so far as super structure is concerned and the same is confirmed by the First Appellate Court in M.A.No.10011/2017.

The reasons assigned for rejecting the application is that the claimant has not produced the material so far as Sy.No.191 is concerned and there is no NC:
2024:KHC:51232 document to show that there are super structure on the land in Sy.No.191.

sentences.text: In this appeal, the claimant has filed an application for seeking amendment and the said application is allowed permitting to make the amendment to the claim petition.

4. The proposed amendment sought for is as follows:
"The appellant/petitioner submits that the residential house acquired by the 1st respondent for the benefit of the 2nd respondent was situated in S.No.110 of Begadhalli Village, Nagar Hobli, Hosanagar Taluk and not in S.No.191 of Begadhali Village.

It is submitted that, even if the house was situated in S.No.110 of Begadhalli Village, the petitioner/appellant is entitled for the fare compensation, as per the Notification issued by the Government of Karnataka which is already marked in the case, as per PWD/SR for the year 1983-84 without any depreciation along with all statutory benefits.

Therefore, the petitioner/appellant is entitled for the compensation as determined by the Court Commissioner along with all statutory benefits NC: 2024:KHC:51232 S.A. @ 30 percent under Section 23(2) of L.A.Act and additional amount of 12% from the date of 4(1) Notification till the date of Award, as per the provisions of Section 23(1)(A) of the L.A. Act and the interest at 9% for the 1st year and at the rate of 15% after one year of acquisition till the date of payment of full compensation, as per the provisions of Section 34 of the Land Acquisition Act."

5. Therefore, since in view of the fact that the amendment is made, it is necessary to receive evidence regarding whether there are super structure on the land in Sy.No.110 or whether the super structure is in Sy.No.191.
Hence, the matter is required to be remanded to the Reference Court for the purpose of further receiving evidence by both the sides.

Therefore, the order passed by the Reference Court in LAC No.1/2011 and MA No.10011/2017 requires to be set aside and the matter requires to be remanded to the Reference Court for fresh disposal in accordance with law.

6. Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
NC: 2024:KHC:51232 ORDER (i) The Miscellaneous Second Appeal is hereby allowed.

(ii) The order dated 21.11.2017 passed in M.A.No.10011/2017 by the V Additional District and Sessions Judge, Shivamogga, sitting at Sagar and the order dated 24.08.2016 passed in LAC No.01/2011 by the Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Sagar are set aside.

(v) All the contentions of the parties are left open.
